# A projection landing while the overflow menu opens closes the menu

This is the successor to #18348, which PR #18353 closed. #18348 left one question open, and this ticket answers it with a local reproduction.

## Context

`component/tab/OverflowAction.spec.mjs:162` (*renders first, outside focus gating, with measured non-overlap and ordinary menu activation*) failed the `components` job in 15 of the last 25 failed `Engine Tests` runs, from 2026-09-08 to 09-14. Five of those failures were on `dev`: 34228960926, 34253760041, 34355808406, 34400460345 and 34580274841. Every failure looks the same: the overflow menu opens, its first item resolves, and the click times out because the item "was detached from the DOM".

#18348 bound the item by id, so the arm now fails naming it. Its open question stayed open: does the menu re-render after it is shown?

## The Problem

The failure reproduces locally in Playwright Chromium with `Emulation.setCPUThrottlingRate` at 6. The arm's own steps fail 4 of 20 runs and 5 of 30 runs. A plain open-and-click without the arm's layout reads fails 0 of 20.

A DOM mutation trail recorded identically on all 5 failures (ms from when the observer attached; the control's `pointerdown` lands at about 38):

| ms | mutation |
|---|---|
| ~44 | `+` tab header buttons 7 and 8 |
| ~89 | `+` `neo-menu-list-1`, mounted with records 1 and 2 |
| ~110 | one batch: `+` records 3, 4 and 5; `−` records 1 and 2; `−` header buttons 6, 7 and 8 |
| ~176 | `−` `neo-menu-list-1` |

Reading the trail against the source: at ~44, the restored header buttons match `#project`'s recapture, which restores hidden buttons so it can measure them. At ~110, one batch applies a new split with three tabs hidden and rewrites the open menu's items. The menu closes about 65 ms later. A user who clicks the control while a projection's measurement is still in flight hits the same window; throttling only widens it.

## The Architectural Reality

- `Overflow#queueOpenMenuProjection` (`src/tab/plugin/Overflow.mjs`) parks a projection only while `menuList.mounted` is true, and `#project` calls it again at the mutation boundary, just before `applySplit`.
- `button.Base#toggleMenu` sets `menuList.hidden = false` synchronously. `mounted` turns true only after the shown menu's vnode has been inserted. A projection whose `getDomRect` resolves between those two moments passes both checks.
- `Overflow#syncControl` then writes `menuList.items` for the changed signature. Its own idempotence note says a rewrite rebuilds the dropdown and closes it mid-interaction.
- `#restoreOpenMenuPartition` runs on the menu's mounted edge. It already handles part of this case: a recapture that made hidden headers visible while the menu was opening.

## The Fix

This is a candidate until the reproduction confirms it. Park while the menu is open or opening (`menuList && !menuList.hidden`) instead of only while it is mounted. A projection that resolves after the click then parks, and drains on the menu's unmount edge as it does today.

## Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] A red-first arm, with no CPU throttling, shows that a projection resolving after `toggleMenu` shows the menu but before the menu mounts is parked. The open menu's items and the header partition stay untouched.
- [ ] The CPU-throttled open-and-click reproduction above fails on `dev` and passes 60/60 with the fix.
- [ ] A projection requested while the menu is open still drains once the menu closes. A projection requested while the menu is closed still applies immediately.
- [ ] `OverflowAction.spec.mjs` passes in full.

## Out of Scope

- Header actions evicting tab buttons in narrow dock zones (#18693). That is the documented repartition, not this race.
- When projections run, and the menu's item rewrite outside the opening window.

## Related
